quest.title: Desert Bloom
quest.description: Nermin is putting a lot of work into taking care of that flower...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Whew... Loosening the soil like this should work...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you still looking after this flower?

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Yep. Granny Kulsoom gave me a lot of tips on taking care of flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Things like loosening soil, regularly trimming leaves, getting rid of bugs using various methods...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Oh, and you shouldn't water them too often, or else the roots will rot.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: *sigh* And I thought watering them every day was the way to go... To keep the soil moist and stuff...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: But it's a good thing, because I don't have to fetch water everyday anymore. The stepwell's really far away.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: I have to continue trimming the leaves. In the meantime, could you fetch a small can of water for me?

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: I've talked to Kazan. He said I could water the flowers today.

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: The watering can is over there. Be careful when drawing water. Don't let too much mud get into the can!

choices.text: Granny Kulsoom taught you all that?

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: Mm... Kinda. Granny Kulsoom knows everything. I always go to her when I have questions.

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: I'm counting on you! One small can of water will do.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Oh no... There's more bitten leaves...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Traveler, look! That kitten is chewing on my flowers again!

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Look at this leaf over here... That one too! They all have large chunks bitten off!

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: That's also what Raef said. He even went around to feed the kitten...

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: But the next day, the kitten came back to nibble on my flowers.

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: The kitten just munches on leaves for now. What if it starts biting the stems? ...That would be a disaster.

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: But I don't want to chase it away either. If it leaves the village, it'll have nowhere to go but to the desert...

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: Traveler, could you help me feed the kitten again? I hope it doesn't come nibbling at my flower leaves again. They're not even tasty to begin with...

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: Anyway, thanks for agreeing to help. I'll mark the kitten's favorite spot on your map...

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: Meanwhile, I'm gonna stay here and watch my flowers in case another little cat comes along and takes a chunk off the leaves...

choices.text: I'm somewhat of a cat expert.

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: That would be great! Whenever I see cat paws, I'm worried that the cat'll pounce at me with its claws out...

choices.text: Perhaps the kitten... enjoys chewing on plants?

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: I'm not sure what it likes...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Traveler, perfect timing! Come have a taste of the Minty Bean Soup I made.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The ingredients in your soup...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: I asked someone to buy most of the ingredients for me, but as for Mint... I grew them myself.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Raef gave me a set of gardening tools and some fertilizer.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: I thought it would be a waste to use them on one single pot of flowers... So I asked Azalai to buy some Mint seeds for me.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: After planting the Mint seeds, I took care of them just like how I take care of the flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: As time went on, the Mint grew and matured...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: So I picked some and made this Minty Bean Soup. What do you think? Tastes pretty good, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Um... Since you ate my Minty Bean Soup, you have to do me a favor.

choices.text: Uh, I'm not done eating yet...

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: Hey, I was just joking! I'll give you a nice reward for your help.

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: I just need you to pick three Zaytun Peaches for me. They're Raef's favorite fruit.

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: I wanna add them to my Minty Bean Soup and bring it to him.

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: Now that I know how to make Minty Bean Soup, I just need someone to get the Zaytun Peaches for me.

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: Thanks! I'll treat you to another bowl of Minty Bean Soup when you get back.

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: I'm counting on you, Traveler. Find some Zaytun Peaches and bring them back to me.

choices.text: Is he allowed to eat soup while at work?

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: It's not gonna take up that much of his time. Besides, he's not too busy with work.

choices.text: You can take this bowl back!

talks.objective: Go back and water the plants

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Did you fetch the water?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: If this counts...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Great! I'm gonna start watering the flowers. Please wait a second...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Nermin starts watering the flowers...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Whew. This should do it...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Granny Kulsoom says that when you're watering plants, you should stop when the water starts seeping out from below the flower pot.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Because that means the soil has been "soaked through." You need to water them once every three days...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Ah! Sorry, I got carried away... Here's the reward I promised. Thank you for helping out, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Which tool should I use for trimming leaves...

dialogues.speaker: Lazy Cat
dialogues.text: Meow? Meow meow meow!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! We aren't bad guys! Don't get so worked up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This should be the cat Nermin was talking about. Let's give it some food.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You place the food in front of the wary cat.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It really likes the food. Paimon guesses this will do. Let's report back to Nermin.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Traveler, did you find the kitten?

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: Great! I hope it doesn't mess up my flowers again... Cat food is supposed to taste better than flower leaves, after all.

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: Thanks for your help, Traveler. Here, this is your reward.

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: *sigh* I hope the kitten doesn't get hungry too soon...

choices.text: I think the kitten's full now.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Thank you. I need to cut them into pieces, then put them in my Minty Bean Soup...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Nermin starts making her special Minty Bean Soup...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Done! Hmm... It doesn't look any different than the regular Minty Bean Soup...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: But I'm sure it's gonna taste different!

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Traveler, please bring this bowl of Minty Bean Soup to Raef.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: I have to make a few more servings for Granny Kulsoom. Ebeid and Hilmi said they wanted to try some too...

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: I won't! It's just a few bowls of Minty Bowl Soup, not a big deal at all!

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: Anyway, please bring this Minty Bean Soup to Raef.

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: I have to prepare some for Nawaz and Ramiz as well...

response.speaker: Nermin
response.text: Well... Since I'm finally able to actually do something meaningful, I have to make the most out of it.

talks.objective: Bring the drink Nermin made to Raef

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: I have to prepare some for Nawaz and Ramiz as well...

talks.objective: Bring the drink Nermin made to Raef

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Minty Bean Soup... Did Nermin make this herself?

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: So that's why she's been acting all mysterious lately. I heard that she bought a few flower pots, too... I wondered what she planted in them.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Not that it's a bad thing. At least she won't be spending all her time worrying about her health.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: There's still another batch of goods I need to take care of. Once I bring them back into the village, I'll try her soup.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Oh, and here's a little something for you. Thank you for coming all the way here.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Traveler, have you found the Zaytun Peaches?

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Ugh... Why are there so many bugs on the leaves?

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Why does the kitten like nibbling on leaves...? I wonder what they taste like...

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Hey Traveler! Didn't expect to see you here. Do you need any help from me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nermin wants to give you this.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Huh, why is there another batch of goods coming in all of a sudden...
